Gap_Description: No external security audit penetration test or independent ISMS review has been conducted or published.
Remediation_Action: Commission annual penetration test by CREST-accredited firm; engage external ISMS auditor for readiness review; publish summary findings.

Control_Name: Inventory of Information and Other Associated Assets
Gap_Description: No information asset register or data-flow inventory exists; assets supporting CI/CD release signing and contributor data are not formally identified.
Remediation_Action: Create and maintain an asset register covering GitHub repos CI/CD pipelines secrets/credentials and release artefacts; map data flows to identify personal data processing.

Gap_Description: No DLP controls or secret scanning enforced in CI pipeline; secrets accidentally committed would not be automatically detected or blocked.
Remediation_Action: Enable GitHub secret scanning push-protection; add Gitleaks as a required CI check; rotate any previously exposed secrets.

Gap_Description: No supplier security assessment or third-party risk policy; critical suppliers (GitHub HackerOne cloud runners) have not been assessed against security requirements.
Remediation_Action: Develop supplier risk questionnaire; complete risk assessments for critical third parties; include security clauses in new supplier agreements.

Gap_Description: No formal SSDLC policy or mandatory security gates; PHP static scanner exists but is not enforced in CI pipeline.
Remediation_Action: Formalise SSDLC policy; add Psalm/Semgrep as mandatory required CI check on all PRs to stable branches; introduce threat modelling for new features.

Gap_Description: HackerOne triage process documented in SECURITY.md but no formal IRP with roles escalation paths communication templates or severity matrix is published.
Remediation_Action: Draft and publish formal IRP covering detection triage containment recovery and post-incident review; assign RACI; conduct tabletop exercise.

Gap_Description: PHP static scanner repo exists but not enforced as a required CI check; insecure code can merge without automated security validation.
Remediation_Action: Configure SAST as a required status check in GitHub branch protection rules for all stable branches.

Control_Name: Responsibilities After Termination or Change of Employment
Gap_Description: No formal offboarding procedure; departing contributors GitHub org membership access to CI/CD secrets and pipeline permissions may persist indefinitely.
Remediation_Action: Create offboarding checklist: revoke GitHub org membership rotate shared secrets audit remaining access; automate via GitHub org management APIs.

Gap_Description: No network segmentation for CI/CD pipelines; a compromised GitHub Actions runner could access long-lived secrets and pivot to production credentials.
Remediation_Action: Migrate to ephemeral self-hosted runners; implement OIDC token federation to eliminate long-lived CI secrets; review and restrict workflow permissions.

Gap_Description: No information classification scheme defined; all project data treated without differentiated protective controls.
Remediation_Action: Define 4-tier classification scheme (Public/Internal/Confidential/Restricted); apply labels to key data assets; update access controls accordingly.

Gap_Description: No backup policy for critical project infrastructure including CI/CD secrets release signing keys and GitHub organisation configuration.
Remediation_Action: Define RPO/RTO targets; implement encrypted offsite backups of signing keys and critical secrets; test recovery quarterly.

Gap_Description: No formal post-incident lessons-learned process; repeat vulnerability classes have appeared in advisories suggesting no systematic root-cause remediation.
Remediation_Action: Establish post-incident review process; publish anonymised lessons-learned summaries after major incidents; feed findings into SSDLC.

Gap_Description: No BCP/DR plan for critical project infrastructure; loss of GitHub org access or signing keys would halt releases.
Remediation_Action: Document BCP covering key-person risk GitHub org recovery release-signing key escrow and emergency communication channels.
